_read_me: Every number the planner uses that is not typed in by the family lives here. Each entry has value, unit, source and as_of. A value of null with source TODO means it has not been checked yet; the app shows 'not set yet' instead of guessing.

default_interest_rate.note: Shown as the starting value in the budget form. Families can type their own rate either way.

default_term_years.note: Shown as the starting value in the budget form.

assessment_ratio.note: Georgia taxes a share of a home's value. DESIGN.md mentions 40% but it needs a cited source.

forsyth_county.note: One rate for all Forsyth homes. The data has no tax district, so city vs. unincorporated can't be told apart.

homestead_exemption.note: Only applies to a primary residence. Rules differ by county.

homeowners_annual.note: Could also be a percent of price; decide when the source is found.

annual_rate.unit: percent of loan amount per year
annual_rate.note: Real rates depend on credit score and down payment.

required_below_down_payment_percent.source: DESIGN.md section 6 (still needs an outside source)
required_below_down_payment_percent.note: Mortgage insurance is added when the down payment is under this.

housing_share_of_gross_income.note: DESIGN.md mentions 28% and says to check it against HUD or CFPB before citing. Shown only as a reference line, never as a rule.

comfortable_min_left_percent.unit: percent of take-home pay left after all monthly costs
comfortable_min_left_percent.note: At or above this share left = Comfortable.

stretching_below_left_percent.unit: percent of take-home pay left after all monthly costs
stretching_below_left_percent.note: Below this share left = Stretching. Between the two = Tight.

alpharetta_model_to_sale_ratio.unit: model estimate divided by sale price (median)
alpharetta_model_to_sale_ratio.source: housing_model_v2.ipynb, sales check cell: 308 Alpharetta sales in 2025 (warranty deed, land and building, $100k+)
alpharetta_model_to_sale_ratio.note: Spread around this ratio was 22% (COD), so the adjusted range is rough. Not applied to Forsyth: no sales were tested there.
